desc:
Most Recent Update (v1.18):
- Fixed missing color on Russian Empire 2
- Added every German state flag
- Added every Japanese prefecture flag
- Added 17 historicals

Paint the flags of your favorite countries!

There are over 200 flags of countries, regions, and territories, including:
- All 193 officially recognized UN member states
- Various Pacific/Caribbean island territories
- Regions of countries (England, Scotland, Puerto Rico, etc.)
More flags will be coming in later updates.

Paint Flags does not intend to be disrespectful to any country or culture.

heavily inspired by paint an album, please check it out if you enjoy this game.
